description: REQUIRES prior nps_edi__auth__npki_session__login call with same account_link_id. Issue the NPS membership certificate (EC02, Korean or English) for one subscriber. IRREVERSIBLE: the certificate is issued at 국민연금공단 and stays in the application results list; the same subscriber cannot be issued again within 24 hours. Call without confirm first to get a preview, show it to the user, then retry with confirm=true. Never set confirm=true on your own. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and receiving their explicit approval. Omit it on the first call to obtain the preview.

member_name.description: Subscriber name. If several share it, pass row_index or row_key instead.

row_index.description: options[].row_index from the subscribers list tool

row_key.description: options[].row_key from the subscribers list tool
